parsed_json.up: Select distinct molecule ChEMBL identifiers and canonical SMILES for compounds tested in assays against human deoxynucleoside triphosphate triphosphohydrolase where the assay organism is human. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, assays, and target_dictionary. Require compound_structures via INNER JOIN. Filter target by pref_name and assay by assay_organism. Return compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by compound_chembl_id.
